## Submitting an Access Request via SailPoint ISC API

Use the **POST /v3/access-requests** endpoint to grant a user access to a role, access profile, or entitlement.

### 1. Get a Bearer Token

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" \
  -d "grant_type=client_credentials&client_id={clientId}&client_secret={clientSecret}"
```

### 2. Submit the Access Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {token}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["<identity-id>"],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
        "id": "<access-profile-id>",
        "comment": "Requesting access for project onboarding"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

### Key Parameters

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `requestedFor` | Array of identity IDs to receive access |
| `requestType` | `GRANT_ACCESS` (or `REVOKE_ACCESS` to remove) |
| `requestedItems[].type` | `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ROLE`, or `ENTITLEMENT` |
| `requestedItems[].id` | The ID of the access item to grant |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | Optional justification comment |
| `requestedItems[].removeDate` | Optional ISO-8601 date to auto-revoke access |

### Python Example

```python
import requests

tenant = "your-tenant"
token = "your-bearer-token"

payload = {
    "requestedFor": ["2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
        {
            "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
            "id": "2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1314",
            "comment": "Needed for Q3 project access"
        }
    ]
}

response = requests.post(
    f"https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests",
    headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json=payload
)

print(response.status_code)  # 202 Accepted on success
```

A `202 Accepted` response means the request was queued. You can then poll **GET /v3/access-request-status** to check its progress.

  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/access-request-status
    api_version: v3

```
